# Report Readability Requirements Checklist: Management Report Readability

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the Management Report readability and evidence-fidelity requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope and Information Architecture

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact six sheets, their order, active sheet, and distinct reader question specified without overlap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the boundaries between Management Report, technical CARIO + Gantt workbook, future Project Workbook, and Project Setup Workspace explicit and mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §Scope Boundaries, §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the replacement-in-place behavior clear enough to prevent a second competing management export or endpoint? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Export Contract §User action]
- [ ] CHK004 Are full Kanban, round-trip import, source selection, and source write-back explicitly excluded from this increment? [Completeness, Spec §Out of scope]

## Reader Language and Anti-Slop Rules

- [ ] CHK005 Are recognized identity prefixes, repeated bracket prefixes, hierarchy arrows, entity-kind labels, and Markdown decoration defined precisely enough for deterministic removal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Data Model §Reader-facing text policy]
- [ ] CHK006 Do the requirements protect meaningful bracketed text, Vietnamese diacritics, punctuation, and business meaning from over-cleaning? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Reader-facing text policy]
- [ ] CHK007 Are `Chưa ghi nhận`, `Chưa phân công`, and concise recency wording assigned to unambiguous missing-data conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK008 Are forbidden raw enums, validation codes, absolute paths, repeated provenance, and generated narrative consistently excluded from all first-five-sheet requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Workbook Contract §Shared reader-language contract]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the prohibition on AI/LLM paraphrasing distinct from deterministic presentation cleanup and source-meaning preservation? [Clarity, Spec §Scope Boundaries, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Can the requirement that one cell communicate one idea be reviewed objectively against the defined sheet columns and content ownership? [Measurability, Workbook Contract §Shared reader-language contract]

## Executive Summary Requirements

- [ ] CHK011 Are the five management questions and their display order fully specified for `Tổng quan`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the at-most-five action rule accompanied by a defined destination for the complete relevant population? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Acceptance Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK013 Are empty or missing summary states defined for no action, no next milestone, no owner, and no supported progress? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the 60-second comprehension outcome tied to concrete facts a reviewer can ask the reader to identify? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## 30-Day Operating Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 Is the operating window defined exactly as reporting date through 29 calendar days later? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Are decisions/blockers, overdue unfinished work, active work, and intersecting planned work/milestones complete and ordered without category ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Are eligibility rules clear for decisions outside the schedule window and work entirely outside the window? [Coverage, Spec §US4, Data Model §Membership and deduplication]
- [ ] CHK018 Is stable-target deduplication precedence specified for a work item qualifying under multiple operating categories? [Clarity, Data Model §Membership and deduplication]
- [ ] CHK019 Are action, consequence, owner, required date, state, and minimum schedule context defined as separate row responsibilities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the empty state and landscape readability requirements defined without implying a full Kanban workflow? [Consistency, Workbook Contract §Sheet 2]

## Plan and Actual Evidence Fidelity

- [ ] CHK021 Are all five Actual evidence shapes mutually exclusive and exhaustive for supported evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-012]
- [ ] CHK022 Is finish-only evidence explicitly a completion point rather than a one-day duration or inferred start? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK023 Is effort-only evidence explicitly undated and distinguishable from missing execution evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK024 Are percentage eligibility, formula, invalid-input cases, and no-zero-substitution behavior fully quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK025 Are parent Actual roll-ups constrained by explicit evidence coverage so partial evidence cannot appear as whole-scope completion? [Consistency, Data Model §Actual presentation]
- [ ] CHK026 Are continuation markers, pre-window overdue context, and reporting-boundary behavior specified without moving factual endpoints? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Workbook Contract §Calendar]
- [ ] CHK027 Is fail-closed behavior distinguished from sparse-but-valid evidence for every contradiction class that affects export truth? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, Export Contract §Errors]

## WBS Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Is WBS membership limited unambiguously to Project, Phase, Work Package, and Delivery Card, with milestones and gates excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK029 Are numbering, parentage, depth, canonical order, and independence from dates/execution fields defined together? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Hierarchy and numbering rules]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the eight visible primary columns exact, ordered, and protected from optional-group collapse? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017–FR-018]
- [ ] CHK031 Is `Hạng mục` constrained to a meaningful name while `Mã` owns stable identity exactly once? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the initial row-outline state explicit that Project, Phase, and Work Package are visible while every Delivery Card remains expandable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK033 Are all fields in the Plan, Actual, Relationships, and Evidence column groups enumerated and assigned to independent collapsible groups? [Completeness, Workbook Contract §Optional column groups]
- [ ] CHK034 Are dependency and minimal relative source-reference requirements consistent with the ban on technical clutter and absolute paths? [Consistency, Data Model §WBS row fields, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK035 Is unresolved-parent behavior specified so no canonical row is silently dropped or falsely reparented? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Hierarchy and numbering rules]

## Detail, Metadata, Safety, and Acceptance

- [ ] CHK036 Are reader-first ordering, one-row-per-Delivery-Card identity, filtering, frozen context, and blank typed missing values complete for `Chi tiết công việc`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK037 Are authority, source identity, snapshot, baseline, contract, revision, dates, planning window, and limitations centralized exclusively and completely on `Thông tin báo cáo`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Data Model §Report metadata]
- [ ] CHK038 Are official-only selection, preview/proposal exclusion, non-importability, immutability, and unchanged technical workbook behavior mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026–FR-028]
- [ ] CHK039 Are color meanings paired with required text/symbol cues and are screen/print priorities defined per sheet rather than as a vague global style goal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024–FR-025]
- [ ] CHK040 Are deterministic output, zero state mutation, five-second fixture performance, exact hierarchy reconciliation, forbidden-content scanning, and visual review all objectively measurable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002–SC-011]

## Notes

- Depth: Standard formal pre-implementation review.
- Reviewer/timing: Human reviewer at the mandatory design gate before `$speckit-implement`.
- Focus: Reader comprehension, deterministic language cleanup, Actual evidence truth, WBS disclosure, authority safety, and measurable workbook acceptance.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
